name: DJ Muggs
sources: Albumism — Muggs Presents… The Soul Assassins: Chapter I at 25 (https://albumism.com/features/dj-muggs-soul-assassins-muggs-presents-the-soul-assassins-chapter-i-turns-25-anniversary-retrospective)
notes: Los Angeles by address, boom-bap by grammar. Two documented parameters separate it from everything around it. First, swing: the research says "heavy swing", which at 0.64 is the heaviest 16th swing on this axis. Second, the motif shape — "dissonant, narrow-interval motifs" from psych-rock, jazz and horror-soundtrack sources — so `intervals.step` is 0.78, the narrowest here, with `halfStepDissonance` at 0.22 and `motifPitchCount` capped at four. The low-pass filtering that is his signature process is not an audio effect this engine has, so it is expressed where a style model can express it: the hat velocities are pulled down, the perc gain offset is the lowest on this axis, and the melody register drops to [60,80] while the bass sits at [24,41]. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick`, not a held note, and that is an engine limit.** The research says thick filtered sample bass, sustained and loud; `reese_sustain` emits one note per chord and saturates, so `mirror_kick` at `followRootsProb` 0.93 over a kick playing 1 and 3& is the nearest honest thing. ⚠ `medium` because the research rates it medium-high — the catalog breakdown is documented, the drum numbers are not. The specific inferred parameter is `percs.gainOffsetDb` at -8, which is this author's translation of "everything low-passed so the mix reads murky by design". ⚠ The i–VII family is INFERRED; the research names static i and i–iv only. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2,4], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
